about: Card 10C-1b: a held-out set, written after the first measurement and before the combination rule was tuned on ja_name_lines.json, committed before the tuned rule first ran on it, and measured once. Same licence and conventions as ja_name_lines.json: every line invented, names invented (見本, 架空, 仮名, 模擬, 例, 試, or an ordinary surname and given name drawn separately), no hospital named. `names`: 30 lines with an unlabelled name; `ordinary`: 30 ordinary lines chosen to tempt a name tagger.
